title: K2 Space slider
description: A section title with two square arrow buttons, over a row of large edge-to-edge photo slides that butt together with no gap (75vw × 40vw on desktop, tall portrait cards on phones), the next one peeking in. Each slide has a 32px title and a short paragraph in its lower-left corner. The title reveals line by line and the photos settle from 115% and blurred to sharp as the row scrolls in; arrows step one slide.
notes: slides are a native scroll-snap row (swipe on phones); the arrows need JavaScript
each slide carries a `dark` scope so its caption stays light over footage in light mode
the photo scrub runs on a named view timeline on the row, because the row itself is a horizontal scroller
name: k2space-slider
